author: KEXP
description: Wevilla-based band Derby Motoreta's Burrito Kachimba explode with flamenco-inspired psychedelic rock. Live on KEXP from Bilbao with host Albina Cabrera, they share a high-energy performance of "Prodigio" and more.
title: Derby Motoreta’s Burrito Kachimba performs "Prodigio" Live on KEXP in Bilbao

author: KEXP
description:
